rites.name: Nualaema
rites.text: Nualaema is the Weaver of Lantern-Thought in the realm of Orienna, a concept of pure arcane potential that gives shape to every spell and song. Her first act of making was to sing a single note that became the first starlight, and scholars of the arcane still trace their formulae back to that tone.

rites.name: Siluarae
rites.text: Siluarae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Orienna, an invented omniverse, as it stood in its second era. She is envisioned as a spider-throned sovereign of hidden caverns, whose will is woven into silken threads that bind the minds of those who bow to her. Her essence is said to hold entire underground seas of shadow, enough to hollow out a planet's crust.

rites.name: Miallioma
rites.text: Miallioma is the hearth-lord of the Veyl Deeps, a concept of the sealed-ember faith who kindles the first furnace that the lesser artisan-spirits worship. Its devotees believe it hammers resolve into the bones of those who labor in stone and flame. Its power is measured in the vast sparks it scatters across the underground seas.

rites.name: Asheshora
rites.text: Asheshora is the concept of the Ember Court, the trial-bearing assembly of Orienna that judges oaths and binds the new doors between worlds during the Age of Sundering. Its law is that every promise broken in one realm must be answered in another, a principle its councils enforce through ritual weight rather than open war.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is the concept of Orienna's Seeding, the age when makers plant the Weave into the substance of the world and the quiet powers lie dormant beneath it. It is remembered less as an event than as a stillness in which latent forces wait to wake. Its character rests on patience rather than violence.

rites.name: Silinnys
rites.text: Silinnys is the quiet loom-mind of Orienna's arcane currents, a concept held by scholars to be the thread-keeper that lets spellwork hold its shape across the realm. Her age is three, so her threads are young and still learning to bind without fraying.

rites.name: Nuelys
rites.text: Nuelys is the Weaver of Quiet Memory, an arcane principle that binds the scattered echoes of forgotten inventions into living lattices of thought. In the Orienna age of the Sixth Era, its influence is felt in every archive where ink and spirit are kept together.

rites.name: Ryeliel
rites.text: Ryeliel is the living principle of the harvest in Orienna, a concept rather than a person, felt most strongly where furrows are sown in the early dawn. Her presence is said to coax seed to wake under frost and bind the roots of the land together through the lean seasons.

rites.name: Mierlae
rites.text: Mierlae is a sovereign of bitter dominion in the Orienna cosmos, a patron whose followers bind the weak under chains of fear and rancor. Those who serve it are the Veilmasters of the Ashen Concord, who plant suspicion in every hearth and reap obedience from it.

rites.name: Ilyemora
rites.text: Ilyemora is a concept of pure deception and bloodshed in the Arcane realm of Orienna, woven from the rumors whispered between rival factions of the E6 era. It is said to thrive wherever a promise is broken and a knife is hidden behind a smile.

rites.name: Veneiraenae
rites.text: Veneiraenae is the Vow-Flame of Orienna's Arcane realm, a concept that burns in those who swear oaths to protect the weak and keep their word. Its power is measured not in raw destruction but in how much a sworn defender will endure for another. Its champions are said to carry its fire into any ruin.

rites.name: Venemiel
rites.text: Venemiel is the Vigil-Keeper of Orienna's Arcane realm, a sleepless sentinel whose gaze stands over the seventh age's fragile wards. Those who take up the duty of guarding others receive a fraction of Venemiel's unblinking attention, and the god's silence is said to hold back the slow tide of ruin.

rites.name: Nuareina
rites.text: Nuareina is the Veiled Arbiter of Orienna's Arcane realm, an ancient presence who weighs every oath and every wrong with a balance that never tips toward favor. She wears a blindfold of woven starlight so that no face, rank, or fame can sway her scales.

rites.name: Sileinniel
rites.text: Sileinniel is the weeping power of endurance in Orienna's Arcane realm, the quiet force that keeps the weary standing through famine and grief. Those who bear suffering for others draw upon her tears as a shield, and she is said to answer every sustained sorrow with a little more strength.

rites.name: Ilyeraemiel
rites.text: Ilyeraemiel is the concept of first light given will, a radiance that ripens seeds and wakes the sleeping in the Arcane realm of Orienna. In the sixth era it is little more than an eager, newborn presence, its power measured in the dawns it has coaxed into being.

rites.name: Elaennys
rites.text: Elaennys is a moon-spirit of the Orienna cosmos, a silver-veiled presence who tends the pale roads that travelers walk after dark. She gentles the restless blood of those cursed to change with each full moon, offering them a quiet hearth in their own minds.

rites.name: Oriannys
rites.text: Oriannys is the veiled concept of hidden hungers in the Orienna cosmos, a silence that gnaws at moonlight and swallows what is whispered in the dark. Her influence spreads through the deepest hollows of the arcane realm, where forgotten things pool into a restless tide of unspoken dread.

rites.name: Lyirioma
rites.text: Lyirioma is a concept of tender ardor woven into the Arcane realm of Orienna, a force that kindles longing wherever hearts are willing. In the sixth era, her influence is said to glow like banked coals beneath the seams of old oaths and new vows alike.

rites.name: Eluarlaera
rites.text: Eluarlaera is an arcane concept woven into the ley-currents of Orienna's third age, worshipped by no temple but by every blade that has ever tasted fear. Born two ages ago from the collective will of contending armies, it is said to answer any oath sworn over a drawn weapon, sharpening the sworn party and dulling the other without favor.

rites.name: Ilyalae
rites.text: Ilyalae is the drifting patroness of fortunate chances in the realm of Arcane, a concept rather than a deity with a temple. Travelers who gamble on uncertain roads whisper her name when a coin lands true or a storm passes them by.

rites.name: Lyineth
rites.text: Lyineth is the Maid of Misfortune in the Orienna omniverse, a concept of ill fortune that tangles the threads of chance in the Arcane realm of the E6 era. Her rival twin of good luck is never far from her, and their contest shapes the odds that ordinary mortals live beneath.

rites.name: Alairleimys
rites.text: Alairleimys is the tempest-spirit who rules the restless grey deeps of Orienna, worshipped by seafarers in the drowned chapels of the Shattered Coast. Her moods are said to raise tidal walls that have overturned whole fleets, though sailors leave her offerings of salt and silver to keep her temper cool.

rites.name: Ilyanae
rites.text: Ilyanae is the storm-tide of Orienna's seas and skies, a concept of ruin that the coastal peoples name with trembling breath. Those who survive its wrath credit it with drowning cities and unmaking the works of mortal hands, yet no temple ever dares to claim it. It is feared rather than adored, and its name is spoken only at dusk.

rites.name: Lyirlae
rites.text: Lyirlae is a concept of commerce woven into the Arcane realm of Orienna, a force that binds the exchange of goods into a single shimmering ledger. She is said to grant fortune to whoever keeps honest accounts, and to call debts back from anyone who lies about their worth.

rites.name: Ilyamaerora
rites.text: Ilyamaerora is a patient spirit of making who kindles clockwork hearts inside stone and teaches the thing it builds to outlast its maker. In the fifth age of Orienna, its workshops are said to hum beneath the mountains, and every seal it forges still holds when the world around it cracks.

rites.name: Lyirae
rites.text: Lyirae is a concept of silence woven into the Arcane realm of Orienna, an ember of memory that gathers what the living forget at the end of each age. Born two ages ago, she tends the quiet tide where spent names drift toward their rest.

rites.name: Ilyaleirys
rites.text: Ilyaleirys is the untamed hunt-spirit of the Veilmarch, a concept worshipped by feral trackers who believe the wild itself calls them to the chase. Its gifts flow through scent, claw, and the tide of migrating herds rather than through any fixed temple or shrine.

rites.name: Siluamiel
rites.text: Siluamiel is a sovereign of the Arcane realm of Orienna, a patient spirit who was born from the first unbroken grove and who rules the untamed growth that reclaims abandoned ruins. Its followers are wayfarers who speak to roots and bark rather than to any temple, and it answers only through the slow turning of seasons and the sudden bloom of thorn-walls.

rites.name: Miamaenneth
rites.text: Miamaenneth is the sovereign of the Hushfell, a concept of deep winter's indifference that the people of Orienna personify as a silent weaver of ice. Her faithful do not pray for mercy but simply hang grave-markers of frozen glass so the frost remembers their names.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a minor concept of the Arcane realm in Orienna, a quiet patron of those who weave spells from borrowed starlight. Its followers claim it taught the first hedge-mages to bend thought into flame and frost during the third age of the Orient sky.

rites.name: Siluara
rites.text: Siluara is the invented concept of a quill-bearing intelligence that inscribes the margins of Orienna's oldest archives, its power rising and falling with each sentence it commits to vellum. Scholars across the realms treat its marginalia as both blessing and warning, since a line written by Siluara can quietly rewrite the ink that survives it.

rites.name: Elirluannae
rites.text: Elirluannae is the Quiet One of the Orienna realm, a concept of stillness that stirs the Arcane era's softest waters. Her presence is said to calm the rivers that feed the valley springs and to hush the falls that cut the hills.

rites.name: Sileina
rites.text: Sileina is the concept of festive gladness as it lives in the Arcane realm of Orienna, a force that kindles celebration wherever it is named. Her presence is felt as sudden laughter that spreads through crowds and lifts the weight of mourning from the grieving.

rites.name: Oriimennora
rites.text: Oriimennora is the Thorned Mother of Orienna's Arcane realm, a deity who lends her strength to those who endure ache willingly. Her faithful measure their devotion by carving sigils of suffering into their own flesh under the pale moons of the Kessa Vale. Her power rises in proportion to the endurance she is offered.

rites.name: Oriarwen
rites.text: Oriarwen is the Choirwarden of Orienna's Arcane age, a concept of resonance who binds every spoken line and sung verse into the slow tides of the world. Bards across the realm carry fragments of its voice, and each unfinished melody quietly steadies the weather of distant valleys.

rites.name: Oriinnys
rites.text: Oriinnys is a silver-tongued oracle of Orienna's Arcane realm, whose gaze threads the probable paths of every living thing. Bound for a crime against the realm's weaving, he now speaks only through a lens of frozen starlight that few dare to touch. His prophecies still bend the fates of kings, though he is always the last to know how they end.

rites.name: Miirlemeth
rites.text: Miirlemeth is a concept of venom and blight in the Arcane realm of Orienna, a power that governs how sickness and toxin spread through living things. In the sixth era, her influence was said to seep into wells and wounds alike, leaving sealed vaults of corrupted air where nothing grew for generations.

rites.name: Siliomerys
rites.text: Siliomerys is the invented war-sovereign of the Arcane realm of Orienna, worshipped by commanders who trace their campaigns across lattices of inked squares. In the third age of the sixth era she is said to have arranged a single engagement so precisely that its foreseen outcome briefly bent the surrounding battlefield into compliance.

rites.name: Venaemora
rites.text: Venaemora is an invented concept in the Arcane realm of Orienna, a presence woven from resonant tones, lantern-light, and the slow turning of dancers. She is held as a symbol of second chances, answering those who wish to set down the shadows their lineage has cast upon them. Her influence is felt most where song and moonlight meet in quiet defiance.

rites.name: Droktoth
rites.text: Droktoth is a concept of Orienna, a thinking-shape that the Library of the Three Futures uses to catalogue branching endings during the age of the first sovereign. It moves through the groves and growing kingdoms as a quiet pressure that sorts possibilities into their proper shelves.
